method: Full 2x8 factorial over mapping-menu size and the three service resources on the selected chip. S(mask)=original Baseline 2 reference / exact cell time. Shapley value over the four factors averages all 24 insertion orders; it satisfies efficiency, so the four values sum exactly to S(final)-S(capped old menu).
added_over_v5: Eight cells per workload that hold the extended menu while service is capped were never computed. v5 read the menu factor only at the fully capped corner, which is service-bound; the 24 orders it recorded permuted the three resources and left the menu first.
scope: Exact finite-kernel and descriptor replay with independent chosen-cost reconstruction. Same installed memory, banks, ports, clock, host path, source graph, arithmetic, KV owners, weight retention and paid first imports in every cell. No new OCS search, no source/lifetime admission, no physical timing.
